invariants: The only target is the fixed HTTPS workbench-snapshot GET for notary_team_01 and NAC-SYN-MATTER-001.
All phase dispatches share one inclusive ceiling of exactly 50000 target dispatches.
No phase receives an unconditional 50000-request allocation.
Every failed, timed-out, authentication-failed, redirected, throttled or aborted target attempt consumes the global dispatch budget.
Client retries and automatic redirect following are disabled.
Without current authoritative tenant SharePoint tier, request allowance and resource-unit allowance evidence, preflight status is BLOCKED.
Capacity evidence is revalidated before every target dispatch and after idle periods; the initial owner-approved attestation and latest valid attestation are both hash-bound.
Baseline plus planned load remains at or below 50 percent of both verified tenant allowances in every applicable authoritative allowance window.
Azure Monitor execution units never exceed 120000 GB-s and AlwaysReadyUnits is exactly zero.
Azure Monitor evidence has its own source hash and is never falsely presented as the SharePoint capacity source.
Cold start is VERIFIED only when server instance or start epoch changes; every other outcome is INCONCLUSIVE.
Authentication failure, redirect, throttle signal or target drift aborts without retry.
A persisted fatal response terminalizes after resume without another target dispatch.
Capacity or Azure Monitor failures terminalize the active phase before any later resume can dispatch.
PASSED evidence represents exactly the canonical 50000-request phase plan; smaller successful test fixtures are never accepted as release evidence.
The committed activation receipt is verified against the current fixed Azure BFF function, workspace and synthetic matter binding.
Every successful fixed-target response passes the same canonical exact projection validator used by the runtime projection boundary.
Evidence contains aggregates only and no per-request record or raw response, token, body, URL, tenant, user, instance or epoch identifier.
No phase writes, rolls back, deletes, changes permissions or credentials, or restarts, scales or reconfigures infrastructure.
Live execution remains owner-gated and bound to PASSED activation evidence and immutable capacity and phase-plan hashes.
The runtime itself invokes mandatory authorization, capacity, transport-binding, durable-checkpoint and runtime-safety ports before dispatch.
No live CLI is exposed until authoritative Microsoft 365 capacity, Azure Monitor and exclusive-lease adapters are implemented and verified.
Invalid preflight, state, target or evidence fails closed before another dispatch.
